name: Create Issue
description: Create a new issue in a repository, optionally with labels, assignees, and a milestone. Provide the repository as an `owner/repo` string. Labels and assignees are passed by name/login (e.g. `bug`, `octocat`) — setting them requires push access to the repo. [See the documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/issues/issues#create-an-issue)
